title: Timeline
description: src/app/data/timeline.json — one entry per month. The site groups them by year and sorts them itself, and shows only work if present, else courses, else certs and projects.

monthLabel.description: Three-letter month, one normal space, four-digit year, e.g. "Jan 2026". Must be unique.

hidden.description: true keeps the month in the data but off the site.
